      <openPorts>[{"port":445, "host":"192.168.1.10", "isTCP":"false"}]
      <timestamp>2023-07-15T14:00:00Z</timestamp>
      <scanMethod>native-net</scanMethod>
    </message>
  </root>
</protocol>
```

- `scanMethod`: The method used for scanning the network.
